switch.step1: Switching to {new} a little at a time. Step 1 of 3: it answers about 1 time in 10. After {threshold} of its turns without trouble, it answers half the time. Shadow watches your turns only until this switch ends.
switch.step2: Step 2 of 3: {new} now answers half the time. Trouble so far: {new_trouble} of {new_turns} turns on {new}, {old_trouble} of {old_turns} on {old}.
switch.step3: Step 3 of 3: {new} now answers all the time. After {threshold} more turns without trouble, it becomes your default.
switch.assignment_unit: Shares apply to new conversations. Each conversation keeps its model as the steps advance. Progress counts turns on {new}.
switch.done: Done. {new} is your default model. Before: {old}. Shadow has stopped watching your turns.
switch.rollback.requests: You're back on {old}. Shadow paused the switch. The last 3 requests to {new} failed in a row, after {new_turns} turns on it. This can be a provider hiccup. Nothing else changed. Your chats, settings and test result are as they were. Shadow won't resume by itself.
switch.rollback.trouble: You're back on {old}. Shadow paused the switch. On {new}, {new_trouble} of {new_turns} turns hit trouble ({signals}). On {old} over the same days, {old_trouble} of {old_turns}. This can be bad luck. Nothing else changed. Your chats, settings and test result are as they were. Shadow won't resume by itself.
switch.rollback.mixed_models: Shadow paused the switch because the provider returned different models within one turn. The next turn uses {old}. Shadow won't resume by itself.
switch.resume: Resumed. Step 1 of 3: {new} answers about 1 time in 10 again. Trouble counts start from zero.
switch.stop: Switch stopped. You're on {old}. Shadow has stopped watching your turns. The test result is kept.
switch.undo: You're back on {old}. The switch is over and Shadow has stopped watching your turns. Nothing else changed.
switch.undo_pending: Shadow is already moving you back to {old}. There's nothing else to undo. Run /shadow status to see where it is.
switch.undo_default: You're back on {old}, and it's your default again. Chats that were already open move back on their next turn.
switch.manual: You changed models yourself, so Shadow stopped the switch. You're on {chosen}, as you chose.
switch.watch_start: Your default model is now {new} (was {old}). New chats use it. To move this chat now, send /model {slug}. It's on another provider, so this switch can't be gradual. Shadow watches the next 20 turns on {new} and switches back if it breaks. That catches breakage, not a small drop. Shadow watches your turns only until those 20 are done.
switch.watch_done: {new} ran 20 turns with trouble on {new_trouble}. The watch is over and Shadow has stopped watching your turns. {new} stays your default.
switch.watch_trip.requests: You're back on {old}, and it's your default again. In {new_turns} turns on {new}, 3 requests in a row failed. This can be a provider hiccup. Nothing else changed. Shadow won't switch again by itself.
switch.watch_trip.trouble: You're back on {old}, and it's your default again. In {new_turns} turns on {new}, {new_trouble} hit trouble ({signals}). This can be bad luck. Nothing else changed. Shadow won't switch again by itself.
switch.watch_trip.mixed_models: You're back on {old}, and it's your default again. Shadow paused the switch because the provider returned different models within one turn. Shadow won't switch again by itself.
switch.watch_undo: You're back on {old}, and it's your default again. The watch is over. Nothing else changed.
switch.current_chat_restore: To move this chat back now, send /model {slug}.
switch.signals_limit: Counted as trouble: requests that failed to finish a turn, turns you stopped, /retry or /undo requested straight after, and observed tool failures. Malformed tool-call coverage is incomplete.
switch.status.idle: Shadow: nothing running. Shadow isn't reading your turns.
switch.status.restore_pending: Shadow: moving you back to {old}. Not finished yet.
switch.status.step1: Shadow: step 1 of 3, {new} 1 time in 10. Last: {last}.
switch.status.step2: Shadow: step 2 of 3, {new} half the time. Last: {last}.
switch.status.step3: Shadow: step 3 of 3, {new} all the time. {remaining} of {threshold} to go.
switch.status.paused: Shadow: switch paused after a rollback. You're on {old}.
switch.status.done: Shadow: nothing running. Last switch: {new}, done {date}.
switch.cli.help: Try a model on your own work, then switch a little at a time.
switch.error.no_result: No saved test allows this switch.
switch.error.busy: A switch is in progress. Finish it or undo it first.
switch.error.compatibility: Gradual switching is waiting for the exact model pair to pass its compatibility check. Run hermes shadow doctor --verify-pair to check it. Nothing changed.
switch.error.invalid: This switch action isn't available in the current state.
switch.error.config: Shadow couldn't finish saving the model defaults. The saved switch keeps the pending change. Run /shadow status to try again.
switch.config_interrupted: Shadow stopped retrying an unfinished default change to {pending_model} on {pending_provider}. The saved provider and model may differ. Run hermes model to choose your default. Your current chat choice is left in place.
switch.error.manual: You changed models yourself. Shadow left your choice in place.
switch.doctor.ok: Shadow setup is ready. Nothing changed.
switch.doctor.other_model: at least one other model to try
switch.doctor.judge: a model that can act as judge from a third maker
switch.doctor.pair_registry: Gradual switching needs live Hermes runtime compatibility proof for the exact model pair in plugins.entries.shadow.settings.verified_gradual_pairs. Run {command} shadow doctor --verify-pair <old-model> <new-model> --provider <provider>, or save an eligible test and run {command} shadow doctor --verify-pair. The check carries full turn history through Hermes and rejects replayed sealed reasoning. Run /shadow doctor after saving an eligible test to see its route entry. Fixture tests do not authorize a pair. Nothing changed.
switch.doctor.pair_missing: Missing live Hermes runtime compatibility proof for this exact pair in plugins.entries.shadow.settings.verified_gradual_pairs. Run {command} shadow doctor --verify-pair to check the saved test's exact pair. Shadow saves the entry only after both live turns complete with carried history and the first reply. The check rejects replayed sealed reasoning. Fixture tests do not authorize a pair. Entry template: {entry}
switch.doctor.pair_ready: Exact-pair runtime compatibility proof is recorded in plugins.entries.shadow.settings.verified_gradual_pairs. Nothing changed.
switch.doctor.version_old:
Hermes {version} does not meet plugin.yaml requires_hermes {requirement}.
Fix: {command} update
switch.doctor.version_unknown:
Hermes version could not be detected. Required by plugin.yaml: {requirement}.
Fix: {command} update
switch.doctor.models: Models Hermes exposes with usable credentials:
switch.doctor.no_models:
Usable models: none confirmed
Fix: {command} model
switch.doctor.discovery_unavailable:
Hermes model discovery is unavailable.
Fix: {command} model
switch.doctor.judge_available: Third-maker judge: available for at least one comparison pair.
switch.doctor.credentials_unknown:
Hermes has configured models with credentials Shadow cannot confirm without reading credential files or calling a provider.
Fix: {command} model
switch.doctor.isolation_required: Replay context and memory isolation are not verified. Run the setup check before starting a test: /shadow doctor --verify or {command} shadow doctor --verify
switch.override.untested: Shadow hasn't tested {new} on your turns. Switch anyway?
switch.override.unbacked: Shadow has no passing test for {new}. Switch anyway?
